title: Babylonian captivity of the Judeans
summary: Nebuchadnezzar II of Babylon besieged Jerusalem and sent its elite citizens to Babylon, an episode known as the Babylonian Captivity. A Babylonian chronicle dates the capture of the city and its king to early 597 BCE; deportations are dated 597 to 587 BCE, with Jerusalem destroyed in 587/586 BCE.

uncertainty.note: Sources give 598/597 for the first capture and 587/586 for the destruction; both spans are shown as years.

importance.justification: The deportation of Judah's elite to Babylon followed the fall of Jerusalem and is a defining episode in the history of the Judeans.
